_comment: Copy this file to sync-config.json and fill in your values. sync-config.json is gitignored.

AzureAD._comment: App Registration (service principal) in your Azure AD tenant.
AzureAD._comment_secret: Use CertificateThumbprint (preferred) OR ClientSecret. Store secrets in Windows Credential Manager, not here.

AttributeMap._comment: Maps Azure AD (Graph) property names to on-prem AD attribute names.

Kerberos._comment: Realm must be the AD domain in UPPERCASE. KeytabOutputPath must be ACL'd to the service account.

ServiceAccounts._comment: One entry per service that needs a Kerberos keytab.

PKINIT._comment: Certificate-based Kerberos authentication (no password required for end users).
PKINIT._comment_source: CertificateSource: 'EntraCBA' = fetch from Graph authentication/certificateMethods endpoint.

EntraCloudSync._comment: Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync agent — authoritative source for password hashes / Kerberos keys.
EntraCloudSync._comment_installer: Download the agent installer from the Entra portal (Entra ID > Hybrid Management > Cloud Sync) and place it at AgentInstallerPath before running Install-EntraCloudSync.ps1.
EntraCloudSync._comment_scope: SyncScope: 'AllUsers' or a specific Azure AD Group Object ID.

Sync._comment_dryrun: Set DryRun to true to log all changes without writing to AD.
Sync._comment_disabled: When true, users removed from Azure AD are disabled in on-prem AD (not deleted).
